tier: TIER 2 — place manually before market close
session: Place at NY close 22:00 Oslo — hold overnight — exit at London open 10:00 Oslo

rules.catalyst_required: Only trade assets with a clear overnight catalyst: geopolitical event, earnings next day, major data release
rules.entry: At key support or resistance level
rules.stop_loss: Must account for overnight gap risk — wider than normal. Never hold overnight unprotected.
rules.take_profit: At next key resistance or support
rules.position_size: 0.5% of portfolio only — reduced size for overnight gap risk
rules.exit_rule: Close position at London open 10:00 Oslo unless strong reason to hold
rules.best_assets: Gold, Oil, major forex pairs, BTC — these have the most overnight catalysts and liquidity
